pictures.name: ZSA1-Rude-Village
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. A dusty village of mud-brick houses in Punjab in the early 1500s, late afternoon. Villagers in rough homespun turn their backs and shut wooden doors, one man jeering. In the lane stand two travelers: Mardana, a Muslim musician with a greying beard, a simple cap and a rabab (a lute-like stringed instrument) on his back, and Guru Nanak in a long saffron-brown robe and simple turban, seen only from behind. The Guru is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.

pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting in the same style, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern scene painted like an old master. No readable text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos. Evening kirtan in a modern gurdwara hall: men, women and children with covered heads sit together on a white sheet on the floor, a woman plays a harmonium and a young man plays tabla drums, warm lamplight, everyone at one level, a few singing, some just listening with closed eyes.
